_comment: Fixed channel library (plan: Channel library). The model may only pick ids from this list; code rejects anything else. 'weight' is w_channel in the exposure formula and is HAND-SET: tune and record changes in the README. 'touches' lists the node TYPES a channel may touch. 'default_touches' are used only when a query has no preset; they are a placeholder (see README: open design question).

channels.name: Tariffs and trade policy
channels.description: Import duties, quotas, trade deals and trade disputes that change where and how ore and steel are sold.

channels.name: Sanctions
channels.description: Sanctions on countries, companies or people that restrict trade or finance.

channels.name: Permits and regulation
channels.description: Mining permits, environmental approvals, royalties and regulation.

channels.name: Infrastructure and demand
channels.description: Construction and infrastructure spending that drives steel and ore demand.

channels.name: Currency and rates
channels.description: Exchange-rate and interest-rate moves that change producers' costs and revenues.

channels.name: Conflict and security
channels.description: War, unrest and security incidents near assets or routes.

channels.name: Labour and protest
channels.description: Strikes, blockades and protests at mines, railways and ports.

channels.name: Weather and disaster
channels.description: Storms, floods, earthquakes and other hazards near mines or export ports.
